actualPromptText:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: raw production 2D side-view game animation sprite sheet
Input images: Image 1 is the project-owned Korari Stalker identity reference only. Preserve its species identity, silhouette, palette and material language, but create wholly new original fan-made/project pixels and new poses; do not copy or trace any source pixels or exact source pose.

Create ONE production sprite sheet of Korari Stalker for Aliens: Tantalus Frontier, animation move.
Identity lock: PROJECT_ORIGINAL / NO_EXTERNAL_MODEL: original Tantalus Frontier low forest quadruped predator, strict right profile, wedge head with natural lateral eye and sensors, one jaw, four supple limbs, charcoal/moss organic hide with bark patterning, sparse dim cyan flank photophores and one long flexible non-bladed balance tail. Korari is setting context only. Exclude xenomorph, Yautja, technological and borrowed-franchise anatomy.
Archetype Korari Stalker; modifier Standard. This profile has its own authored source; do not silently reuse or recolor another profile.
Animation: Locomotion matches the species and reference limb count; no xenomorph anatomy added.
Exactly eight individually authored chronological poses, four columns by two rows, strict row-major order. One character per cell. Each pose wholly inside its cell with generous equal gutters.
Strict gameplay side view facing RIGHT, no camera rotation, no perspective change. Retain identical skull, limbs, materials, colors, outfit and proportions across all poses and all clips.
Use one consistent physical scale and ground contact line. Full body and entire tail or weapon visible, no cut limbs, no cell overlap, no labels or grid lines, no logo, no UI.
True transparent RGBA background if available; otherwise a perfectly flat pure magenta background, no shadow, checkerboard or scenery. No interpolation or duplicates.
Preserve the supplied reference design as closely as possible; the output remains subject to visual review, not a guaranteed 1:1 replica.

Frame-by-frame motion lock, row-major: 1 low rear-paw contact and forward reach; 2 weight compression; 3 first passing pose; 4 opposite forepaw reach; 5 opposing rear-paw contact; 6 second compression/passing pose; 7 final reach with tail counterbalance; 8 recovery that closes a seamless low stalking-run cycle. Four distinct limbs remain readable, with alternating contacts, supple spine motion and no subject translation across cells.
Layout enforcement: use a wide landscape canvas with eight equal imaginary cells in exactly 4 columns by 2 rows. Do not draw cell borders. Every cell contains exactly one complete identical Korari Stalker, centered with generous empty gutters on every side. Keep the same long low 176x88 gameplay envelope, torso length, shoulder height, orthographic distance and ground line in all cells. The muzzle points RIGHT in all eight cells; never mirror it.
Background enforcement: use one perfectly uniform solid pure #FF00FF chroma field over the entire canvas, including gutters. No transparency checkerboard, gradient, texture, floor, cast shadow, scenery, text, letters, numerals, captions, icons, logo, watermark, UI or grid.
Anatomy exclusions: exactly one wedge head, one natural jaw, one visible lateral eye/sensor set, four distinct supple animal limbs and exactly one long flexible non-bladed tail. No inner jaw, dome, dorsal tubes, biomechanical ribs, acid, blade tail, mask, armor, dreadlocks, technology, active camouflage, extra limb, missing limb, Earth panther copy or borrowed-franchise creature.
Original fan-made/project interpretation only; canonExact=false; no official or 1:1 claim.

sourceRepairs.result: Eight complete poses recovered across raw cell boundaries, uniformly scaled with one reviewed uniform factor for this complete clip, root/support aligned, and recomposed into an exact opaque-magenta 1774x887 board.

Only declared foreground edge-spill RGB pixels were replaced from nearest original non-spill foreground references; silhouette topology and exact #FF00FF background were unchanged; independent neutral-gray halo audit is zero and original cyan photophore pixels are unchanged.

spillThreshold.topology: foreground-only pixels within Chebyshev distance <= 8 px of exact opaque #FF00FF background

residualMatteHueThreshold.purpose: remove only edge pixels retaining matte-like R/B parity; natural moss and cyan pigments are excluded

deliveryVioletMatteThreshold.scope: all pre-existing foreground pixels in one nominal target cell
deliveryVioletMatteThreshold.basis: independent neutral-background audit of violet-magenta crest, belly, tail and leg contamination

korariLowLuminanceHaloThreshold.scope: all pre-existing foreground pixels; safe because the locked Korari palette contains charcoal, moss and cyan but no authored purple/magenta pigment

independentNeutralBackgroundAuditThresho.purpose: looser independent final audit after compositing the corrected silhouettes over neutral gray

spillThreshold.referenceSelection: nearest original foreground pixel that fails the strict magenta threshold, by expanding Chebyshev radius; within the first non-empty radius choose minimum squared Euclidean distance, then row-major y/x tie-break
spillThreshold.replacement: copy only the selected reference RGB onto the declared spill foreground pixel; never alter alpha/topology because the active sheet is opaque RGB
spillThreshold.fallback: if no source exists inside the local radius, choose the globally nearest original foreground pixel that fails the soft threshold using the same deterministic distance/y/x ordering
invariants: only pre-existing declared spill foreground pixels may change RGB
all exact #FF00FF background pixels must remain byte-identical
declared spill pixels after correction must equal zero

note: Profile-local move candidate only; processing and technical QA do not imply art acceptance, normalization, runtime integration or a global state write.
